name: Tunnel, greenhouse and vegetable farming
shape_facts: Number and size of tunnels or greenhouses, and any open-field area
Main crops (cucumber, tomato, capsicum, leafy greens, strawberries, herbs) and how many cycles a year
Growing system: soil, drip, hydroponic, vertical
Selling route: mandi beopari, arhti, supermarkets, hotels and restaurants, direct boxes, online
Workforce size and whether a farm manager runs it
Power and water source (grid, solar, generator, well, tanker, desalinated water)
Whether they raise their own seedlings or buy from a nursery
scope_rule: pi notes business and operational problems: harvest and dispatch tracking, prices received versus market, wastage in transit and at buyers, supermarket and HORECA order and invoice management, labour scheduling, input and packing stock, utility and cooling costs, and owner visibility. pi does not advise on crop choice for profit, climate control settings, nutrient recipes, fertigation, pesticide or fungicide use or doses, pest and disease identification, or food-safety certification rules. It records buyer and staff roles, never names or personal numbers.

vocabulary.tunnel: a plastic-covered hoop structure for off-season vegetables
vocabulary.off-season: growing outside the normal open-field window to catch high prices
vocabulary.nutrient tank: mixing tank for hydroponic or fertigation systems (pi notes cost and breakdowns only)
vocabulary.beopari: trader who buys at the farm gate or in the mandi
vocabulary.punnet / clamshell: small plastic pack for berries and herbs

problems.phrase: Cucumber price crashed the week our whole tunnel came on at once
I don’t know what each tunnel earns after costs
Beopari sets the rate and I just accept it
Supermarket rejects part of every delivery and deducts it later
Hotel orders come on WhatsApp at midnight and we miss some
Invoices to restaurants go unpaid for 60, 90 days
Tomatoes rot in the van because delivery runs late
Harvested quantity and dispatched quantity never match
Electricity and cooling bills eat the margin in summer
Generator diesel goes missing
Poly sheet tore in the storm and replacement took weeks
Seedlings from the nursery were poor and half the trays failed
Packing punnets and labels run out before big orders
Workers don’t follow the daily task list in each tunnel
Labour leaves after Eid and I start from zero
Pump or drip failure noticed only after the plants suffer
Each buyer wants a different pack size and labelling
Food-safety audit paperwork takes days to put together
I can’t see harvest per tunnel per week without calling the manager
Box subscribers cancel and I don’t know why
No website, people find us only by word of mouth
We list on delivery apps but stock shown is wrong
Want to add five more tunnels but not sure the last ones paid back
Planting dates are guesswork, so everything ripens together
Canada: seasonal staff shifts and hours are on paper
Bank and lender want reports I can’t produce quickly

selling: Who buys most of your produce right now?
buyer orders: How do orders from shops or hotels reach you?
What goes wrong with them most often?
rejections and wastage: Where do you lose the most produce, at the farm, in transport, or at the buyer?
How do you find out how much?
tunnel economics: Do you track costs tunnel by tunnel or all together?
What would you most like to know per tunnel?
utilities: Which running cost worries you most, power, water or diesel?
How do you check it against use?
inputs and packing: How do you know when packing material or seedlings need ordering?
Has a shortage stopped a delivery?
labour: How many workers do you have across the tunnels?
How are tasks given and checked each day?
maintenance: How do you find out a pump or drip line has failed?
How long does a fix usually take?
planning: How do you decide what to plant and when?
What happened the last time several tunnels peaked together?
direct customers: Do you sell any produce directly to households?
How do they order and pay?

seasons: Pakistan: tunnel crops are planted in autumn and harvested through winter into spring (roughly November–April) to catch off-season prices; open-field vegetables flood mandis in their main seasons and depress prices. Ramadan lifts demand for salad vegetables and fruit; Eid causes labour gaps; monsoon storms damage covers. UAE: main growing season October–May; summer heat (June–September) means high cooling costs or a pause; hotel and restaurant demand rises with the winter tourism season, Dubai Shopping Festival and Ramadan iftars. Canada: greenhouse production runs most of the year with heating costs peaking in winter; farmers’ markets and CSA boxes run June–October; Thanksgiving and Christmas boost demand.
care: No advice on pesticide, fungicide, fertiliser, nutrient solution, doses, pre-harvest intervals or disease control; pi suggests an agronomist or extension service.
No advice on food-safety, GAP or organic certification rules; pi notes only the paperwork effort.
Chemical exposure, gas build-up from heaters, electric shock from pumps, heatstroke in tunnels: pi tells them to contact emergency services (1122, 999/998, 911) immediately.
Never helps relabel produce as organic or local when it isn’t, or alter harvest dates on labels.
Does not record names, IDs or contact numbers of workers or buyers; uses roles.
Migrant and seasonal worker visa or permit questions are immigration matters; pi does not advise.
Pricing and market outlook: pi does not predict prices.
build_ideas: Tunnel register: each tunnel with crop, planting date, expected harvest window and all costs logged against it
Daily harvest entry by WhatsApp: crates or kg per tunnel per day, with grade split
Dispatch and delivery sheet per buyer, with rejections recorded at the door and photos
Buyer ledger for supermarkets and HORECA: orders, invoices, deductions, payments due, with reminders
WhatsApp order intake for hotels and restaurants that turns messages into a confirmed order list for the morning
Planting calendar that shows which tunnels are due to peak in the same week
Packing and seedling stock tracker with reorder alerts
Utility and diesel log against generator and pump hours
Daily task checklist per tunnel for workers, with photo proof and a supervisor sign-off
Maintenance log for pumps, drips, fans and covers
Subscription box system with weekly orders, skips and cancellation reasons captured
Audit document folder with a checklist of required records

exchange.text: I have 12 tunnels near Sheikhupura. Every season the cucumbers come in together and the mandi rate collapses.
That’s painful, the whole crop hitting the market in the same week. Noted. How do you decide the planting dates for each tunnel at the moment?
Honestly we just plant when the labour is free.
Noted, planting follows labour availability rather than a plan. Who do you mostly sell to, beoparis at the farm or the mandi directly?
